name: KITE Foundation
rootCause: The KITE Foundation detected abnormal KITE token transfers on Ethereum mainnet, confirming that some wallet addresses had been compromised by hackers. The team urgently paused ERC-20 transfers and related cross-chain channels, with no asset losses to users or the project. A new contract was later deployed, airdropping new tokens 1:1 to legitimate addresses based on the snapshot at block 25,692,498, excluding attacker-controlled addresses.

descriptions.text: The KITE Foundation detected abnormal KITE token transfers on Ethereum mainnet, confirming that some wallet addresses had been compromised by hackers. The team urgently paused ERC-20 transfers and related cross-chain channels, with no asset losses to users or the project. A new contract was later deployed, airdropping new tokens 1:1 to legitimate addresses based on the snapshot at block 25,692,498, excluding attacker-controlled addresses.

KITE Foundation detected and contained a private-key compromise on Ethereum in August 2026, pausing all token transfers and migrating to a new contract. Despite aggregator estimates of $13.3M in value at risk, multiple independent news and official statements confirm there was no realized loss,the affected addresses were excluded during the migration, and no Foundation or user tokens were irretrievably transferred. Compromise of one or more private keys controlling KITE Foundation Ethereum wallets enabled potential unauthorized token transfers. Immediate detection and transfer pause contained the incident before any tokens left Foundation or user custody.
